content.short: TON Connect is the standard protocol for secure wallet authorization and dApp communication on TON.
content.description: TON Connect is a foundational infrastructure protocol for The Open Network, designed to provide a secure and standardized way for decentralized applications to communicate with user wallets. It enables seamless authorization and transaction signing across a wide range of platforms, from web-based dApps to Telegram Mini Apps. By providing a unified connection standard, TON Connect ensures that users can interact with the ecosystem using their preferred wallets while maintaining the highest standards of security and privacy. It is an essential tool for developers and users navigating the decentralized TON web.
content.meta: Connect securely to TON dApps with TON Connect. The ecosystem authorization standard on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
